schema_summary.description: Resumo estruturado do schema do banco de dados, políticas e regras de negócio para referência interna do Gemini CLI.

policies.name: Public profiles are viewable by everyone.
Users can insert their own profile.
Users can update own profile.

triggers.name: on_auth_user_created
triggers.action: Executes function handle_new_user() to create a profile for a new user.

triggers.name: on_profile_updated
triggers.action: Executes function handle_profile_update() to denormalize profile data (slug, name, avatar) into the posts table.

columns.name: id
columns.constraints: PRIMARY KEY, GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

policies.name: Users can select all posts.
Users can insert their own posts.
Users can update their own posts.
Users can delete their own posts.
Users can select all follower relationships.
Users can insert their own follow relationships.
Users can delete their own follow relationships.

columns.name: id
columns.constraints: PRIMARY KEY, GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

policies.name: Categories are viewable by everyone.
Users can create categories.
Post-category relationships are viewable by everyone.
Users can manage categories for their own posts.
policies.logic: using(auth.uid() = (SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE id = post_id))

columns.name: id
columns.constraints: PRIMARY KEY, GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

policies.name: Tags are viewable by everyone.
Users can create tags.
Post-tag relationships are viewable by everyone.
Users can manage tags for their own posts.
policies.logic: using(auth.uid() = (SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE id = post_id))

columns.constraints: PRIMARY KEY, GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY

Users can insert their own views.

triggers.name: on_new_view
triggers.action: Increments posts.views_count. Uniqueness is guaranteed by the composite primary key.

handle_new_user.purpose: Triggered on new user creation in auth.users. Creates a corresponding entry in public.profiles.
handle_new_user.logic_summary: Extracts first/last name from metadata, creates a full name (fallback to 'New User'), generates a unique slug via generate_profile_slug(), and inserts the new profile. Includes exception handling.

handle_profile_update.purpose: Triggered on profile update. Denormalizes key profile data to all associated posts.
handle_profile_update.logic_summary: If profile's slug, name, or avatar_url changes, updates these fields in all posts belonging to that user.

slugify.purpose: Converts a string to a URL-friendly slug.
slugify.logic_summary: Removes accents, lowercases, replaces whitespace with hyphens, and removes invalid characters.

generate_profile_slug.purpose: Generates a unique slug for a profile name.
generate_profile_slug.logic_summary: Uses slugify() to create a base slug. If the name is empty, it uses 'user'. Checks for existence and appends a numeric suffix (-2, -3, ...) until a unique slug is found.

handle_new_like/handle_deleted_like.purpose: Manages the likes_count on the posts table.
handle_new_like/handle_deleted_like.logic_summary: Triggered on insert/delete in the 'likes' table to increment/decrement the counter on the corresponding post.

handle_new_dislike/handle_deleted_dislik.purpose: Manages the dislikes_count on the posts table.
handle_new_dislike/handle_deleted_dislik.logic_summary: Triggered on insert/delete in the 'dislikes' table to increment/decrement the counter on the corresponding post.

handle_new_comment/handle_deleted_commen.purpose: Manages the comments_count on the posts table.
handle_new_comment/handle_deleted_commen.logic_summary: Triggered on insert/delete in the 'comments' table to increment/decrement the counter on the corresponding post.

handle_new_view.purpose: Manages the views_count on the posts table.
handle_new_view.logic_summary: Triggered on insert in the 'post_views' table to increment the counter on the corresponding post.
